received_works.body: I always enjoy reading your work. Since I couldn’t make it to Comitia, I bought a poster the other day just to make up for it. If you’re up for it, I’d love to see a scene where Rei and Hinata are just cuddling at home!
If you don't mind, could you please help me with Kerydra in Honkai: Star Rail?🙏

*I will send you again what was no good before. Please excuse all the same sentences below.


Thank you for your help. Thank you for the illustration of Vodka and Journey last time.
This time I would like to ask you to draw Vodka alone. I've written everything you want me to draw, so if the amount is not enough, please hang it up.


Situation
Vodka wins a race, and she hugs her trainer and bursts with joy. I want to compare this illustration with how she is becoming more and more aware of him and becoming a maiden as the days go by since her inauguration. Please fix the trainer with a nudge.
I would like you to indicate in the corner of the image so that I can tell which period Vodka is in. If you don't mind, I would also like to have a dialogue...


Flow
1) Vodka's first victory in a race shortly after inauguration.
Vodka is often seen in official. Nicely pleased. A little reserved in her joy.

2) A little later, first G1 win (in the game, it's about Junior December).
Still not shy. Vodka explodes with joy.

(3) Further months pass, when she wins the Derby (in the game, it would be around May in the Classic).
A little cute. A different kind of smile. I want her to skip the heart mark a little.

(4) Further on, when he wins the G1 in his Xth year in office (in the game, it would be his senior year)
I can't look directly at the trainer with my face bright red. He keeps saying "I love you, I love you" in his head. I would like to see even more heart marks than (3).



That's all. My desires are exploding. I think it would be nice to have a vodka world line like this...
I hope you will consider it.

おはようございます、先生！またskebを開くのを待っていました。

以前のリクエストと同じようにママになったドリームジャーニーの漫画をお願いします。

久しぶりに姉妹と温泉旅行に出かけるドリームジャーニー。 夫は普通にいってらっしゃいと言いますが、娘(1歳)はママと離れたくないと泣き出します。

その夜、お風呂上がりに部屋に戻ったドリームジャーニーにLINEのメッセージが届いています。寝ている娘の様子を夫が写真に撮って、ドリームジャーニーに送ったものでした。

かわいい娘の写真を見たドリームジャーニーは、本当に優しくて幸せそうな笑顔をします。

そして、それを オルフェーヴル が 後ろで 全部 見ていました。それに気づいたドリームジャーニーは少し恥ずかしくて顔が赤くなり、オルフェーヴルはお姉も立派なお母さんになったと感激しています。


このようなストーリーでお願いします！

I'm always looking forward to seeing you!
Please give me a chance to get a copy of the "Meinashiki Shuwachi"!

Hello Hiyo-san,
I have loved your art of Dream Journey for some time now, and I wanted to request some art of my own.

I would like art of Dream Journey in her casual clothes holding her Trainer who has been shrunken down in the palm of her hand. She is looking down at him with a gentle smile, finding his new size cute, while Trainer looks at her new size over him with awe.
Thank you for all the amazing work so far, and I hope you take my request.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Zlw-EUX-5218CdnGsh6ipqVM4qcx1YCN/view?usp=drivesdk

Hi, Hiyosan, nice to meet you.
I always look forward to seeing your wonderful illustrations and contributions!

I would like to send you a request for an illustration of Dream Journey, which was the first time for me to get to know Hiyo-san!

The theme is
The theme is "present the glasses that Journey uses"...!

The composition is
Journey is not wearing glasses.
If you can make a pose in which Journey is not wearing her glasses and she is putting them on herself (in front of her) with both hands, please do so!
The clothes are up to Hiyosan and can be either uniform or plain clothes!

Also, if possible, I would like you to add a line of dialogue.
I would be happy if you could add the following line: "The world you see cannot be seen without me...
I would be happy if you could add "I can't see the world as you see it without me..."...

The size of the illustration is also up to you.

This is the first time for me to make a request on skeb, and I hope I have been able to express it well in words, but thank you in advance!

Thank you very much for your very good illustrations last time. This time we would like to request a crossover illustration between Uma Musume and Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. The character is Drija and the main character Banagher Links, and the composition is like Banagher handing over the handkerchief that Journey dropped. I would like to know if you could illustrate the conversation between Banagher and Journey. Thank you very much.

Thank you for your help. My two favorite Uma Musume guesses are Vodka and Dream Journey, so I would like to request an illustration of these two.

Costume: Both in their uniforms or uniforms.


Situation: The two of them are squeezing each other's sweatshirt by one arm and not letting go. I also love the description of them putting their hands on each other's chests. (I'll leave it up to you to decide which one you want)


Details
I love the two enraptured expressions and the bewildered trainer. I'd like them to skip the hearts and such.
I'll leave it up to you to decide what the trainer is wearing and how far you want to draw it.
If possible, I'd like to see a full smile and a mushy, sparkling expression.
I want Journey to have a modest smirk, and Vodka to be derelicte.


Thank you for your consideration.

This is my first request.

I would like to ask you to illustrate my guesses, Admire Vega and Valcina.

I would like them to be standing side by side, smiling ecstatically at each other (as if they are protective of their trainer).
The clothes should be summer clothes, and the details of the pose can be left up to you.

I understand that there are some points that are unclear, but please do not hesitate to contact me.

https://umamusume.jp/character/verxina

https://umamusume.jp/character/admirevega

Hello, I'm a trainer and I'm looking for a new character for my trainer! Please draw my original character as a trainer with Dream Journey! We have a height difference, but our fears are the same! I believe in your vision and am waiting patiently!

https://imgur.com/a/l9uvd8I

https://umamusume.fandom.com/wiki/Dream_Journey

Hello. I always look at your wonderful illustrations. This time, I would like to request an illustration of Air Messiah wearing the winter uniform of "Happiline Fukui," a railroad company in Fukui Prefecture, for the recently implemented Air Messiah-chan. I would like to see the HapiLine Fukui logo and the Sabae station sign in the upper left corner of the Messiah-chan. Thank you very much.

https://x.com/denshageek/status/1768745667231662460?s=46

Hello again Hiyo-san! I love your umamusume illustrations of mama Vodka and her daughter, and I would like to request an illustration with a similar theme.

https://twitter.com/hiyo____co/status/1708862798527344681?s=46

The character would be Ritona, the same girl from the previous requests.

https://imgur.com/a/KPC38n5

The scenario is that Ritona is a mother and has a cute daughter who looks like her. Their personalities would be different. Ritona is a very cool and serious person, but her daughter is more cute and energetic. You may choose any composition, poses, outfits, and expressions that you like for the illustration! I am simply interested in a scene with a cute daughter and her cool mom!

I always look forward to Hiyo-san's illustrations of Vodka and Gimu.
Please allow me to request Mr. Seabee, my favorite Uma Musume, in Hiyo-san's illustration.

If possible, I would like to use it as an icon, so I would like a close-up of his face!

The outfit should be plain clothes, and the pose and composition can be left up to you.
https://kamigame.jp/umamusume/page/212252516237199227.html

Thank you very much!

https://kamigame.jp/umamusume/page/212252516237199227.html

はじめまして。リクエストさせていただきます。

描いて貰いたいのは、ウマ娘プリティーダービーのモブウマ娘でマリタイムシッパーちゃんというキャラクターです。
https://wiki3.jp/mobumusuzukan/page/741

構図や衣装などはお任せしますので、どうかよろしくお願いします。

https://youtube.com/@user-eh9bg1ve6f

Hiyo-sensei's drawing of Vodka and Gimlet was really nice, so please let me request it.

Character: Vodka and Tanino Gimlet of Uma Musume

Situation: I imagine the two of them standing around talking after training, drinking juice or eating ice cream. Gimlet says something cool and Vodka's eyes light up, and Gimlet looks happy to hear Vodka's eyes light up as well.

Costume: School gym uniform. It is hot after training, so please have both of them wear their jackets wrapped around their waists and their T-shirts rolled up to their shoulders with the hems hanging out, so that they look like they are dressed together. Underwear can be long pants or shorts/bloomers.

We will leave the rest up to you.
Thank you for your consideration.

This is my first commission.
Thank you very much for your wonderful drawings.
I love the vodka that Hiyo-sama draws.

This time, I would like to use Hiyo-sama's work for my smartphone wallpaper.
The characters I would like to use are Vodka and Scarlett in their normal racing uniforms.
I would be more than happy if they have a calm and cool atmosphere.
We will leave everything to you, including the composition and situation. Please draw Vodka as you see fit.

I know it's difficult to draw this picture because my phone is an Xperia and the aspect ratio is 21:9, which is long and narrow, but I would appreciate it if you could draw it that way.

Thank you in advance.

ひよさん、またまたこんにちは！またリクエスト受付中とのことで、私もリクエストさせていただきますね！

以前からあるキャラクター、リトナのイラストをまたお願いしたいと思いました。イラストのテーマは「ジューンブライド」にしたいと思います。今回はリトナはウマ娘ではないでしょう。以下の資料のウエディングドレスを着て、花嫁になります。

https://imgur.com/a/YSOMp0l

場面は、リトナの結婚式の日、夫とロマンチックなひとときを過ごしているところです。夫は、あなたがよく描いているウォッカのトレーナーに似た、黒髪短髪のハンサムな男性にしてください。リトナは普段は真面目な子なので、あまり嬉しそうな表情にならないようにしたいです。でも、具体的なポーズや表情はおまかせします。

Dear Dr. Hiyo

I've been waiting for you!
I've been waiting for this moment!

I apologize for the inconvenience.

This time, we have a request for a male trainer to take care of Air Shakur who has caught a cold.

The details, requests, and settings are as follows
The trainer offers a spoon of porridge to Shakur, who is lying on the bed, and Shakur is eating the porridge with his eyes closed in disapproval.
Shakur has a cooling sheet on his forehead.
In both scenes, the trainer is smiling gently.
In the latter scene, Shakur looks away in embarrassment.
The trainer is sitting on a chair next to the bed.
Please do the above.

The trainer's face and Shakur's attire are left to the teacher.

Thank you again for your cooperation.

はじめまして！
ひよさんの描かれるウオッカとトレーナーが一番大好きです！！
いつも楽しみにしています！

イラスト、依頼させていただきます。
『トレーナーの運転するバイクにタンデムするウオッカ』をお願いいたします。

時間帯は晴れた昼間や夕方を希望いたします。
それ以外の背景やロケーション等はご随意にお願いいたします。
ただ、空想の世界ということで、二人ともノーヘルでお願いしたいです。
また、とびきり笑顔だと嬉しいです。

バイクを併せて描いてくださることは可能でしょうか？
機種に関しては、スクーターやアメリカンではなく、ネイキッドのバイクだと嬉しいです。
とはいえ、ハンドル回り等の一部分だけでも十分ですし、細かいデザインに希望はございません。
ひよさんがトレウオに対してイメージされるバイクも見てみたいです。
ご参考までにホンダ社のURLを「資料URL」欄に記載いたしますので、お役に立てば幸いです。

最後に、PCの壁紙に使用したいと思いますので、もしも可能であれば16:9（1920×1080以上）で作成くださるととてもありがたいです。

以上です。
ご検討の程、何卒よろしくお願い申し上げます。

https://www.honda.co.jp/CB400SF/

またまたこんにちは！今回もリトナちゃんのイラストをお願いしたいと思います。 今回はウマ娘ライブの「Gaze On Me」の衣装でお願いします! ポーズや表情、衣装の色も選べます!

https://imgur.com/a/KPC38n5

こんにちは！ウマ娘作品、とても楽しみにしています。

違うシリーズのキャラクターなのですが、リクエストさせてください。

このキャラクター、リトナの馬娘イラストをお願いしたいのです。クールで真面目な性格で、エアグルーヴにとても似ています。衣装は参考資料の中から、レーシングウェアとして一番かわいいと思うものを選んでください。ポーズや表情も自由自在です。

https://imgur.com/a/KPC38n5

I would like to request Vodka in Uma Musume!

I will leave the expression and situation to you.
Any facial expressions and situations are fine.

Thank you very much!

Dear Dr. Hiyo

Thank you so much for the wonderful illustration of Air Shakur that you did for my last request.

Let me start immediately to talk about this request.

This time, I would like to present a two-shot illustration of Air Shakur from "Uma Musume Pretty Derby" and Gideon, a character from the "Call of Duty Advanced Warfare" campaign.

The setting is that Gideon is Shakur's trainer. The composition should be "two people standing side by side talking seriously looking in the same direction (like they are analyzing together while looking at other horse girls).

We will send you the URL of the playlist of Mr. Bigboy's CoDAW campaign play video on YouTube as a reference.

We understand that this is a difficult request, so you may decline.
Please do not hesitate to contact us.

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJQjHMFm_-MbqcXrZrKvmJmH-k6xQE7tp
